svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-04 Driver monitoring under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4)
svg.desc: 9 cards for F-04 Driver monitoring, one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A; callout: nobody watching, no escalation. M02 Stops Functioning: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A, covered by M01; callout: nobody watching, no escalation. M03 Unrequested Function: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B; callout: forced stop, driver attentive. M04 Function Stuck: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A, covered by M01; callout: nobody watching, no escalation. M05 Excessive Function: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: forced stop, driver attentive. M06 Partial Function: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A, covered by M01; callout: nobody watching, no escalation. M07 Functions Early: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: forced stop too early. M08 Functions Late: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A, covered by M01; callout: nobody watching, no escalation. M11 Function is Delayed: H-09, SG-08 ASIL A, covered by M01; callout: nobody watching, no escalation.
svg.text: The 9 safety-relevant (SC) guide words. Chart: the function (escalation level (warning → alert → forced deceleration)), required vs performed. Scene: what it does to the car.
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Inattention or unresponsiveness not detected, or no escalation to
the no-response reaction (forced deceleration, lockout): the item
keeps controlling the vehicle with nobody supervising (H-09,
DQ-205). While the driver supervises it is latent (S0 rows): it
removes a measure the controllability of H-02/H-06 relies on.
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Monitoring stops during the drive; same as no function.
DM escalates to forced deceleration although the driver is attentive.
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Attention estimate stuck: stuck 'attentive' is the same as no
function; stuck 'distracted' is rated as M03.
Over-sensitive DM: escalation and forced deceleration too often;
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Under-sensitive DM: a non-supervising driver is not detected; same
Escalation steps reached too early; ends in unrequested forced
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Escalation too late: the item keeps driving unsupervised for longer;
Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not
Delayed detection; same as no function.
Scenes are drawn to explain each hazard; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7. Ratings are proposals for review until the I3 confirmation review (WP-C-03 header).
